title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
content: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indices could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
content: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
content: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
content: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
content: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
content: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
content: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
content: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
content: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

title: Nvidia-Backed CoreWeave Is Surging: Here’s What It Means for the AI Boom
content: CoreWeave's 168% revenue jump sent its shares soaring and lifted Nvidia and other AI stocks. Strong demand is reassuring investors, but the cost of building it remains enormous.

title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
content: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

title: Bitcoin Short-Term Holders Send $3.6 Billion in BTC to Exchanges at a Loss
content: Recent buyers are moving billions in Bitcoin to exchanges below their purchase prices, while Binance sees sharp inflows from recently moved coins.

title: This New AI Music Model Is Already Better Than Suno—We Put ACE to the Test
content: ACE Music v1 tops the AI music rankings with more natural vocals and stronger song structure. Our tests found impressive results, though niche genres remain a challenge.

title: Tether's Tiny AI Agent Beats Models 2.5 Times Its Size at Controlling Your Phone
content: BotPsy packs 800 million parameters into an AI assistant designed to manage everyday tasks locally, outperforming larger rivals as Tether expands its push into decentralized artificial intelligence.

title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
content: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close, after a new screen classified them as non-operating companies. This post MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry Danny Baer, Head of Revenue & Investments at Meanwhile, explains how his Bermuda-based company built the world's first fully licensed life insurance carrier that runs entirely on Bitcoin, holding its regulatory capital in Bitcoin and paying out policies in Bitcoin. This post How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: Tavi Costa: Bitcoin “Very Undervalued with “Violent Moves Ahead”
